mentions.name: Domainhq.ai
mentions.description: A domain market tracking tool that monitors domain sales and expired domains and generates reports with Claude as it perpetually analyzes price history over time. It includes a brainstorm feature that suggests domains to buy. The app runs 24-7 self-hosted on a spare MacBook using the author's personal LLM subscription rather than API credits, with registrations and paid subscriptions planned.
mentions.problem: The author's premium .ai domain was getting lowball offers from domain brokers who seemed out of touch with market news and trends, and existing services like Namebio were very limited and expensive.
mentions.source_excerpt: Domainhq.ai suggested its own domain to buy with its brainstorm feature, and tracks domain sales and expired domains, with reports generated by Claude as it perpetually analyzes price history over time.
